summary: 26North BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 2 to its existing Loan and Security Agreement (Subscription Facility). The amendment increases total financing commitments from $450 million to $650 million. The filing is a routine amendment of a credit facility, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change occurred. It is purely a financing agreement modification. No deal terms apply.
